ground_truth.title: County Pets
ground_truth.main_content:
Come adopt a pet!

No adoption appointment needed!

Adoption hours:
Monday - Friday: 1 pm - 5:30 pm
Saturday and Sunday: 11 am - 3:30 pm

Please call 281-999-3191 for an appointment for all other services.

To reclaim your pet:
- Bring proof of ownership such as vet records or photos of your pet when coming to reclaim.
- Remember to bring your valid photo ID when reclaiming your pet.

612 Canino Rd. Houston, TX 77076

We are located on Canino Road between I-45 and the Hardy Toll Road.

Adoption Hours:

1 pm - 5:30 pm Monday - Friday
11 am - 3:30 pm Saturday - Sunday
No adoption appointment needed.

Animal Surrender Hours:

BY APPOINTMENT ONLY.
Please call 281-999-3191 for assistance.

Pet Clinic Hours:

8 am - 5 pm Monday – Friday. Closed 12-1 pm for lunch.
